what_happened: Task 608's target (<leader>as chat pane styling) resolves to the sf1 terminal integration, which only toggles a snacks.terminal window around the external vendor binary ~/.sapience/sf1.py. That file is untracked (no git repo), fetched by plain curl from app.spnc.ai, and silently overwritten by a daily auto-update (confirmed in ~/.sapience/update.log). No change confined to /home/benjamin/.config/nvim can durably add message-part dividers; the fix is either a disposable vendor hand-edit, a PTY-proxy wrapper built inside this repo (pattern-matching on sf1's literal output text), or a separate task in ~/.dotfiles/packages/sapience-flake to reapply the patch at each sapience update. Flagged user_decision in .return-meta.json.
